title: APPrende
tagline: APPrende is a learn to earn platform that empowers individuals to begin their blockchain journey.
description:
The description for this project is based on what we wish we would have completed. We were able to complete a great UI model of Apprende V1. This version of Apprende has a friendly interface for newcomers to easily understand how to get started, and what to expect in their learning journey. 

We open source blockchain fundamentals Module 0 to ensure anyone looking to advance through the courses fully goes through the motions necessary to unlock the next module. The motion necessary is creating a wallet, create a WorldCoin profile to prove they are human, and interacting with our smart contract to mint their first NFT that will provide access to the following module. Using IPFS we are able to store our NFT images, and with Chainlink we are able to set verifiable randomness to ensure each new user is able to mint a unique dynamic NFT. With the superfluid payments we are able to also award users in social tokens to grow their governance power within the community DAO.
how_its_made:
Apprende uses incentives like superfluid’s distribution of DAO tokens and NFTs to onboard the crypto curious to blockchain. Through education modules, and interactive activities we are able to have participants make use of the blockchain technology they are learning about. We use World Coin for proof of humanity, and to ensure only one NFT is assigned per person. As the modules advance, so do the opportunities to interact with more application in the blockchain. Upon a user's arrival to the DeFi Module they are able to make use of protocols like AAVE to stake funds, and The Graph with our implementation of our token dashboard. 

A user is able to learn how to create their wallet, add funds, interact with their wallet, mint an nft to own and/or sell, stake funds, and make use of DeFi protocols all while earning a place within the Apprende DAO. 

With such a project we are able to take a non crypto native from zero to hero! This is something I have been looking for and looking to provide my friends, family, etc.
